messages:
maya: FYI auditor asked for a trace that links the Sept 14 incident to our log retention/archival settings and KMS key usage. They want: CloudTrail/S3 access logs, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey usage, and any RBAC changes that touched the service account. Can anyone pull a small sample export we can hand over by EOD?

sam: I can pull Splunk and CloudTrail slices. For Splunk, this search will show S3 access + KMS events around the window:
```
index=prod_logs (s3:GetObject OR s3:PutObject OR KMS:Decrypt OR KMS:GenerateDataKey) earliest="2025-09-14T00:00:00" latest="2025-09-15T00:00:00" | table _time, src_user, src_ip, bucket, object, kms_key_id, action, request_id
```
I can export as CSV with headers.

alex: Also ensure we include the RBAC snapshot. The incident involved a CI runner service account that was briefly granted cluster-admin in a bad rollout. I've got the rolebinding audit from Git history and the k8s api-server audit logs. Sample kubectl audit query (jq):
```
cat apiserver-audit-2025-09-14.json | jq '.items[] | select(.objectRef.name=="ci-runner-sa") | {ts:.requestReceivedTimestamp, user:.user.username, verb:.verb, namespace:.objectRef.namespace, impersonated:.user.impersonated}
```
I'll attach the repo diff showing the accidental change.

ops_oncall: Heads up — retention exception ticket INC-4821 was opened for a short-term archival delay. That explains why some S3 lifecycle deletes were paused. Ticket link: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/INC-4821. Approver was @jordan. I can snapshot the S3 lifecycle config and the approval email thread.

jordan: Confirmed — I approved the exception; we have the email and the JIRA approval. I'll forward the thread and a signed PDF to attach to the auditor bundle.

sam: One more: CloudTrail Athena can give us KMS usage metadata if we need SQL export. Example Athena: 
```
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId AS principal, requestParameters.keyId AS kms_key_id, resources[1].ARN AS resource_arn
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventTime BETWEEN timestamp '2025-09-14 00:00:00' AND timestamp '2025-09-15 00:00:00'
AND (eventName = 'Decrypt' OR eventName = 'GenerateDataKey')
```
I can run and produce a CSV.

maya: Thanks. Auditor also wants proof of chain-of-custody: exported logs must be SHA256-summed and timestamped. Can deploybot create a reproducible export script and checksum?

deploybot: I can. Will provide a tarball + SHA256 + step-by-step export.sh that uses awscli v2, jq, and sets explicit start/end timestamps. Example snippet in script:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod-cloudtrail/2025/09/14/ ./ --recursive --profile audit && sha256sum *.json > export.sha256
```
Also including a small README with commands used and the environment (AMI, CLI versions).

alex: For vuln triage linkage — include the CVE tracker ticket (VT-2219) that references the vulnerable library change in the CI image. That ticket links to the incident and shows remediation steps.

maya: Good. Let's confirm artifacts we will hand over: Splunk CSV slice, CloudTrail Athena CSV, KMS usage CSV, apiserver audit slice, rolebinding git diff, S3 lifecycle snapshot, INC-4821 approval PDF, export.tar.gz + export.sha256, and the vuln triage ticket link. Who owns assembling the bundle?

ops_oncall: I'll assemble and upload to the compliance bucket with restricted ACLs and generate a presigned URL for the auditor. Will tag the upload with retention 90 days and an access log.

jordan: I'll do the auditor handoff and list the mappings to SOC2 control CC6.2 and ISO 27001 A.12.4 in a one-page cover note.

maya: Great — target: bundle uploaded and URL shared by 2025-09-18 17:00 PT. If anyone hits blockers ping me + ops_oncall. :thumbsup:

sam: On it, will post the Splunk CSV when ready.

deploybot: Export script and checksum pushed to the compliance bucket under exports/5161234567/ (will include manifest.txt).
